import "date"
import "timezone"

// Set the global location context
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur")

badState = (r) =>
    not exists r.state or // CPMS down
    r.state == 4 or // FAULT
    r.state == 5 or // UNAVAILABLE
    r.state == -1   // UNKNOWN

start = today()
stop = now()

from(bucket: "cpms")
    |> range(start: date.sub(d: 10m, from: start), stop: stop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plantStatus")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId == "plant1")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "state" or r._field == "emergency" or r._field == "lockout")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
    |> fill(usePrevious: true)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= v.timeRangeStart)
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: start,
        _value: if badState(r: r) or r.emergency == 1 or r.lockout == 1 then 0.0 else 1.0
    }))
    |> mean()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: now(),
        _value: r._value * 100.0,
        _field: "plantAvailability"
    }))

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "plantStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "remoteMode" or r["_field"] == "plantMode" or r["_field"] == "health" or r["_field"] == "state")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "cpms")
    |> range(start: -5m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plantStatus")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId == "plant1")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "remoteMode" or r._field == "requestOnSource")
    |> last()
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["deviceId"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: now(),
        controlAuthority:
            if r.remoteMode == 0 then 0 // MANUAL
            else if r.requestOnSource == 1 then 1 //"Take Control"
            else 2 //"Auto",
    }))

import "timezone"
import "join"

option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur")

period = ${chartInterval}

cooling =
    from(bucket: "cpms")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "flow")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId == "chwHeader")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "energyFlowRate")
        |> aggregateWindow(every: period, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            _time: r._time,
            coolingLoadRT: r._value * ${GJ_TO_RT}
        }))
        |> group()

power =
    from(bucket: "cpms")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "power")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "totalPower")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId == "main")
        |> aggregateWindow(every: period, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> group(columns: ["_time"])
        |> sum(column: "_value")
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            _time: r._time,
            plantPowerKw: r._value
        }))
        |> group()

joined =
    join.inner(left: cooling, right: power, 
        on: (l, r) => l._time == r._time,
        as: (l, r) => ({ 
            l with plantPowerKw: r.plantPowerKw
        })
    )
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r.coolingLoadRT > 0.0 and r.plantPowerKw > 0.0)

efficiency =
    joined
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            _time: r._time,
            _field: "Efficiency",
            _value: r.plantPowerKw / r.coolingLoadRT
        }))

cop =
    joined
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            _time: r._time,
            _field: "COP",
            _value: (r.coolingLoadRT * ${RT_TO_KW}) / r.plantPowerKw
        }))

spec.query:
from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "plantStatus" and
    r.deviceId == "plant1" 
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "state" or r._field == "emergency" or r._field == "lockout")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${chartInterval}, fn: last)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    "Plant Status":
      if r.lockout == 1 then "Lockout"
      else if r.emergency == 1 then "Emergency"
      else if r.state == 0 then "Off"
      else if r.state == 1 then "Starting"
      else if r.state == 2 then "Running"
      else if r.state == 3 then "Stopping"
      else if r.state == 4 then "Faulty"
      else if r.state == 5 then "Unavailable"
      else "Unknown",
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "Plant Status"])

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "plantStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "remoteMode" or r["_field"] == "requestOnSource")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${chartInterval}, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with "Control Mode": if r.remoteMode == 0 then "Manual"
            else if r.requestOnSource == 1 then "Take Control"
            else "Auto"
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "Control Mode"])

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "plantStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "requestOn" or r["_field"] == "requestOnSource")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${chartInterval}, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with "Schedule Status": if r.requestOn == 1 then "Active"
            else "Inactive"
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "Schedule Status"])

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "plantStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "chillerActionState" or r["_field"] == "coolingTowerActionState")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${chartInterval}, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with _value: if r._value == 1 then "Run"
            else if r._value == 2 then "Staging Up"
            else if r._value == 3 then "Staging Down"
            else "Idle"
  }))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "chillerActionState", "coolingTowerActionState"])
  |> rename(columns: { chillerActionState: "Chiller Action State", coolingTowerActionState: "CT Action State"})

spec.definition:
with chillers as (
	select 
		unnest(array['chiller1','chiller2','chiller3']) as id,
		unnest(array['Chiller 1', 'Chiller 2', 'Chiller 3']) as text
),
chwps as (
select cp.equipment_id as id, coalesce(replace(value::text, '"', ''), '') as chwp from control_params cp where key = 'chiller.chwpId'
),
cwps as (
select cp.equipment_id as id, coalesce(replace(value::text, '"', ''), '') as cwp from control_params cp where key = 'chiller.cwpId'
)
select c.*, p.chwp, p2.cwp  from chillers c left join chwps  p on c.id = p.id left join cwps  p2 on c.id = p2.id
order by c.id
